# Samuel — İngilizce Özel Ders (Antalya & Online)

> English private lessons in Antalya, Turkey (face-to-face) and online across Türkiye, taught by Samuel Ijeluola: 13+ years teaching English in Turkey, TEFL Master Diploma, TESOL, MBA (İstanbul Aydın Üniversitesi). The site is in Turkish and offers a free English level test and a free speaking test.

## What the page offers
- Free 20-question English level test (A1–C1, about 5 minutes, instant result, no sign-up): https://sammyjel.github.io/ingilizce/#test
- Free 10-question English speaking test (A1–A2, about 6 minutes; audio stays on the user's device): https://sammyjel.github.io/ingilizce/#konusma
- Free 20-minute trial lesson
- Lessons: speaking practice, business English and job interviews, IELTS and TOEFL, children and teens (school English, LGS, Cambridge Starters/Movers/Flyers/KET), tourism / hotel / real-estate English
- Free weekly online English speaking club, Thursdays 20:00 (Google Meet)

## Prices (TRY)
- Trial lesson: free (20 min)
- Online lesson: ₺1,000 / 60 min
- Face-to-face lesson in Antalya: ₺1,200 / 60 min
- 8-lesson package (face-to-face): ₺8,800
- Small group (2–4 people): ₺650 per person / 60 min

## Areas
Face-to-face in Antalya (Konyaaltı, Muratpaşa, Lara and nearby). Online from anywhere in Türkiye via Google Meet or Zoom.
